description: Prints a PDF on a printer. Pass exactly one of url (public or signed http(s) URL, fetched once), base64, or filePath (a local file, read by this server). Up to 25 MB. With an ir_live_ key this prints on paper and counts toward the plan; with ir_test_ it runs on a virtual printer.

filePath.description: A file inside the folder this server runs in (or INKRELAY_FILE_ROOT)

idempotencyKey.description: Same key and body returns the first job instead of printing twice. Generated if omitted.

options.description: PDF options. Omitted options use the printer's defaults; unsupported ones are ignored and listed in stateMessage.

paper.description: A name from the printer's papers or customPapers, e.g. A4

qty.description: How many times to print the document

title.description: Shown in the dashboard and the OS print queue

wait.description: Wait until the job is done, error, cancelled or expired, then return it

name: print_pdf
title: Print a PDF
